description: This file defines the SawOscillator class, which extends SynthUnit and implements a sawtooth wave oscillator for MIDI synthesis, including methods for setting pitch, frequency, amplitude, and generating audio samples.

classes.name: SawOscillator
classes.description: A class representing a sawtooth wave oscillator for MIDI synthesizer, providing control over pitch, frequency, amplitude, and phase management.

methods.name: setPitch
methods.description: Sets the pitch of the oscillator using a MIDI pitch value, converting it to frequency.

methods.name: updatePhaseIncrement
methods.description: Updates the phase increment based on the current frequency and scaler.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude (volume) of the oscillator.

methods.name: getFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Returns the current frequency scaler value.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Sets the frequency scaler and updates phase increment accordingly.

methods.name: incrementWrapPhase
methods.description: Increments the phase and wraps it within the range [-1, 1].

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates a sample of the oscillator's waveform based on the current phase and amplitude.
